descriptionHtml:
ASUS Prime B450M-A II AMD B450 AM4 Micro-ATX Motherboard


Build a versatile, high-performance, and future-proof desktop system with the ASUS Prime B450M-A II micro-ATX motherboard. Expertly engineered to support AMD Ryzen 5000, 4000, 3000, and 2000 Series desktop processors, this heavy-duty motherboard offers a rock-solid foundation for mainstream gaming rigs and high-productivity workstations. Featuring an optimized power solution and comprehensive cooling features, it ensures your system remains perfectly stable and cool under heavy gaming or multitasking sessions.


The standout feature of the ASUS Prime B450M-A II is its exceptional modern feature set, highlighted by a dedicated onboard BIOS FlashBack button, allowing you to update your firmware quickly and easily even without a CPU or memory installed. It comes packed with a high-speed PCIe 3.0 M.2 slot for ultra-fast NVMe SSD performance, four DDR4 DIMM slots for memory expansion, and blazing-fast USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-A ports for rapid external data transfer. Enhanced with Fan Xpert 2+ software, ASUS Aura Sync RGB headers, and durable 5X Protection III hardware safeguards, this motherboard delivers premium reliability and flexibility for tech enthusiasts and casual builders alike.
